---
title: Custom callout types reach callout()
format: typst
filters:
  - 15414-custom.lua
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - ['Exercise KIND-exercise APPEARANCE-default', 'Answer KIND-answer APPEARANCE-minimal', 'Note KIND-note APPEARANCE-default']
        - []
      noErrors: true
---

```{=typst}
#let template-callout = callout
#let callout(kind: "none", appearance: "default", ..args) = template-callout(..args, kind: kind, appearance: appearance, title: [#args.named().title KIND-#kind APPEARANCE-#appearance])
```

The filter builds custom callout types with `quarto.Callout()` and shadows `callout()` around each one to set its colours, as callout extensions do.
The template override above it must still receive the custom type as `kind` and the requested appearance.

::: exercise
Do the exercise.
:::

::: answer
The answer.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
A built-in note.
:::
